name: pdf_create
description:
Create PDFs from stash files or text. Use this when the user wants to generate a PDF document from images, text, or data stored in stash.

Examples:
- 'Create a PDF from my stash files' → action: create, files: [file_ids]
- 'Make a PDF with the crypto data' → action: create, files: ['crypto_prices.json']
- 'Generate a PDF report' → action: from_text, text: '...', title: 'Report'
- 'Combine the logo and schedule into a PDF' → action: create, files: ['logo.png', 'schedule.txt']

The PDF is saved back to stash and can be printed or emailed.

space_id.description: Stash space ID containing source files and for output

files.description: List of stash file_ids or stash:// refs to include in PDF

text.description: Text content to include (supports basic markdown headers)
